what_changed: Batteries Regulation adopted: EV-battery BMS must hold up-to-date SoH / expected-lifetime parameters (Annex VII) with read-only access and a BMS software reset function (Art. 14, from 2024-08-18); battery passport with unique identifier (Art. 77, from 2027-02-18)
Euro 7 adopted: in-vehicle battery durability (SOCE/SOCR monitors, minimum performance requirements), on-board monitoring and environmental vehicle passport data for M1/N1 electrified vehicles

Implementing act: type-approval procedures incl. in-vehicle battery durability; prohibition of software/calibration updates manipulating battery durability data and duty to disclose updates affecting that data

Implementing act: OBM system and data incl. battery durability parameters (on-board SOCE/SOCR, odometer), storage, OBD access and over-the-air transmission of OBM data to manufacturer servers with R155 cybersecurity; EVP format and communication
Amends 2025/1706: methods, requirements and tests for in-vehicle battery durability aligned with UN R154 04 / R83 09, in-service conformity of battery durability, templates
UN GTR 22 established: state-of-certified-energy and range (SOCE/SOCR) monitors, minimum battery performance requirements, in-use verification, values to be read from vehicles
Amendment 1: monitor and battery-durability families, revised in-use verification (Parts A/B), new Part C verification of reported virtual distance (V2X / non-traction energy), vehicle survey

03 series: REESS/vehicle must signal warnings for operational failure of REESS controls (6.13), thermal event (6.14) and thermal propagation advance warning (6.15); low-energy warning; isolation monitoring; new transitional provisions
Supplement 4 to 03 series: scope extended to category O trailers with batteries charged by e-axles (Part I and II incl. REESS warnings); active-driving-possible mode defined for trailers
Supplement 1 to 04 series: scope extended to category O trailers with e-axle-charged batteries; active-driving-possible mode for trailers

05 series: thermal propagation verification (initiated cell thermal runaway), warning indication and operating logic, documentation; REESS-vehicle communication compatibility (6.16); preceding series phased out 2027/2029

Supplement 5 to 03 series: advance-warning signal condition for thermal propagation reworded (egress or 5 min), 'common space' display definition, documentation/IP provisions, test acceptance criteria
Supplement 2 to 04 series: same changes as 03-S5 (advance-warning condition, common-space display, documentation)

Supplement 3 to 04 series and Supplement 6 to 03 series (one document): O3/O4 trailers may signal isolation and REESS warnings to towing vehicle via CAN (ISO 11992-2); 6.15 not applicable to trailer-only REESS
Supplement 1 to 05 series: vehicles without driver (categories X/Y); while ADSF-2 active, REESS/isolation warnings transmitted as a logic signal to the ADS
New UN Regulation on cyber security and cyber security management system: CSMS certificate, risk assessment, Annex 5 threat/mitigation catalogue, protection of the vehicle type
Supplement 1: legacy relief for type approvals first issued before 2024-07-01 (CSMS-development and technically infeasible Annex 5 mitigations, with alternative mitigation and feasibility assessment)
Supplement 2: Annex 5 threat 4.1 extended to spoofing of V2X / GNSS messages; mitigation M10 vehicle shall verify authenticity and integrity of received messages
Supplement 3: scope extended to category L vehicles; legacy relief for L types first approved before 2029-07-01
New UN Regulation on software update and software update management system: SUMS certificate, RXSWIN, secure and safe update process, update information to users

01 series: dedicated RXSWIN per UN Regulation type approval affected by software updates; no updates to registered 01-series vehicles without RXSWIN assignment; original-version approvals phased out 2028/2030
First edition: EV remote service and management system, general principles (catalogue entry only)
Revised edition: EV remote service and management system, general principles (catalogue entry only)
First edition: EV remote service and management system, on-board terminal (catalogue entry only)
Revised edition: EV remote service and management system, on-board terminal (catalogue entry only)
First edition: EV remote service and management system communication protocol and data format (catalogue entry only)
Revised edition of the EV remote service communication protocol and data format (catalogue entry only)
New edition of the digital communication protocol between off-board conductive charger and EV (title broadened from charger-BMS protocol); catalogue entry only
First edition of mandatory vehicle cybersecurity technical requirements (catalogue entry only; content not readable)
First edition of mandatory general technical requirements for vehicle software update (catalogue entry only)

Edition 3: technical revision; complete control-pilot sequences (Annex A), normative proximity circuits with/without current coding (Annex B), alternative pilot function (Annex D), combined AC/DC on same contacts

Edition 2 (DC EV supply equipment): adds bidirectional power transfer control (Annex DD), communication and energy-transfer process (Annex GG), thermal-management energy transfer; system A/B/C annexes updated
Edition 2: technical revision; Annex A (system A/CHAdeMO, now incl. charging/discharging station) and Annex B (system B/GB) DC-charging digital communication updated in line with IEC 61851-23:2023

FMVSS 305 amended (GTR 13 electrical safety): electrical isolation monitoring with driver warning (fuel-cell DC sources), shock protection during charging, indicators of possible active driving mode and drive-away prevention while connected to external charging

Final rule establishing FMVSS 305a (replacing 305; 305 amended to apply unless certified to 305a): REESS overcharge/over-discharge/over-temperature/overcurrent protection, warnings for REESS control malfunction and thermal event (documented under new Part 561), light and heavy vehicles
